en: Do you know how you can avoid\ngetting lost in the mountains?\pYou can bend twigs as trail\nmarkers.
Ohhh!\nI did my best!
I want to go home!
Hahaha!\nCan you beat my power?
Oops!\nOutmuscled!
I go for power because I hate\nthinking.
You have a POKéDEX?\nI want one, too.
Shoot!\nI am so jealous!
When you finish your POKéDEX,\ncan I have it?
Um… Do you know about POKéMON\ncosplay?
Well, that's that.
POKéMON cosplay is dressing up as\nPOKéMON for fun.\pCLEFAIRY is a favorite.
My POKéMON techniques will leave\nyou crying!
I give!\nYou're a better technician!
In mountains, you'll often find\nROCK-type POKéMON.
I don't often come here, but I will\nbattle you.
Oh!\nI lost!
I like tiny POKéMON.\nBig ones are too scary!
Hit me with your best shot!
Fired away!
I'll raise my POKéMON to beat\nyours, kid.
I draw illustrations of POKéMON\nwhen I'm home.
Whew…\nI'm exhausted…
I'm an artist, not a fighter.\nI'll go home to draw.
